'''Capital Way''' was a roadway located south of [[Enterprise Commons]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Running east to west, the road turned north and became [[Mainland Boulevard]] at its western edge, and ended at [[Imperial Outpost Alpha]] at its eastern edge. The [[Czerka Corporation Branch Tower]] was accessed by bridges from the roadway.<ref name="TOR" />
